leadText:
Silver Town (Japanese: シロガネタウン Shirogane Town) is an -exclusive location in the Johto region. It is situated at the base of Mt. Silver and its main attraction is the annual Silver Conference.

At least 30 inhabitants are said to be living in the town. However, the population greatly increases during the Silver Conference, when the town receives several s who successfully collected eight Gym Badges from the region's Gym Leaders. There is an Athlete's Village, which consists of a huge Pokémon Center where Trainers participating in the tournament stay at for the duration of the event. There is also a stadium located nearby, where the Silver Conference matches officially take place.
